name: useMicrophoneArray
summary: Multi-mic acoustic array topology, polar directivity, and beamforming controls.
plain: Inspects the physical microphone array on the device chassis (top, bottom, rear camera visor), returns polar pattern directivity, and allows steering the hardware acoustic beam towards the user or scene.
description: Directly queries the Android AudioManager for connected hardware microphones and their geometric coordinates, group mappings, and directivity patterns (omnidirectional, cardioid, hypercardioid). On supported Pixel devices, provides controls to steer acoustic beamforming (towards user, away from user, external) and adjust acoustic zoom field dimension.

returns.name: microphones
returns.desc: Array of physical microphones detected on the device chassis with 3D positions and polar patterns.

returns.name: direction
returns.desc: Current beam direction configured for the microphone array.

returns.name: fieldZoom
returns.desc: Acoustic field zoom dimension ratio from 0.0 (wide) to 1.0 (narrow focus).

returns.name: isSupported
returns.desc: Whether the hardware and platform support acoustic array inspection and beamforming.

returns.name: error
returns.desc: Error message if microphone array query or direction setting failed.

returns.name: setDirection
returns.desc: Steers acoustic beamforming towards the user, away, external, or omnidirectional.

returns.name: setFieldZoom
returns.desc: Adjusts acoustic zoom field dimension (0.0 to 1.0).

actions.name: setFieldZoom(zoom)
actions.desc: Sets the acoustic zoom field dimension (0.0 to 1.0).

agentNote: Requires Android 9+ (API 28+) for microphone querying and Android 11+ (API 30+) for direction steering.
